summary.zh-CN: Transformer 是以 [[term:attention-mechanism|Attention]] 为核心的序列模型架构。它先把输入序列变成一组向量，再用[[term:self-attention|自注意力]]让每个位置按内容从其他位置汇集信息，并用[[term:position-wise-ffn|逐位置前馈网络]]继续变换表示；[[term:residual-connection|残差连接]]和[[term:layer-normalization|归一化]]负责稳定深层堆叠。
summary.en-US: A Transformer is a sequence-model architecture centered on [[term:attention-mechanism|Attention]]. It turns an input sequence into vectors, uses [[term:self-attention|self-attention]] to gather information from other positions according to content, and uses a [[term:position-wise-ffn|position-wise feed-forward network]] to transform each representation. [[term:residual-connection|Residual connections]] and [[term:layer-normalization|normalization]] stabilize deep stacks.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: Transformer 用 Attention 处理位置之间的信息交换，用前馈网络处理每个位置内部的表示变换。
coreConclusion.en-US: Transformers use Attention for information exchange between positions and feed-forward networks for representation transformation within each position.
